LanguageData.VRE_OrganUse_PigskinOnly.description:
It's okay to sell, install and use organs, as well as harvest them, but only from a pigskin, as it is their primary function.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
- For the purposes of this precept, anyone having the pork flesh gene counts as a pigskin.
LanguageData.VRE_OrganUse_PigskinOnly.label: pigskin only
